title: The Alchemist's Grimoire
description: A hooded alchemist in a purple robe stands beneath a floating open book with an eye on its pages, gesturing with a green hand. Behind them are wooden shelves filled with glowing potions, hanging herbs, and red ribbons, all within a vibrant arched alcove under a starry, multicolored magical sky.
prompt: A mystical hooded alchemist in flowing purple robes with green hands stands in an arched alcove, reaching toward a large floating open book that has a glowing eye on its pages. Behind are wooden shelves lined with colorful potion bottles, hanging herbs, and red ribbons. The background is a vibrant cosmic gradient of teal, purple, and gold with floating runes and symbols, in a colorful painterly fantasy style.
